title: Overall description
content:
Overall description

[Character] A female protagonist. Her appearance, costume, and silhouette must strictly match the female protagonist reference. She is a dark new-Chinese-style xianxia swordswoman with long hair, wide-sleeved robes, and a broad flowing skirt. She is always backlit by a huge full moon, remaining a dark silhouette with no brightly lit frontal face. Do not change the costume color or silhouette.

[Setting] Moonlit celestial palace, dark wooden walkways, dark tiled rooftops, hanging white curtains, reflective ground, sea of clouds, deep night sky, and a huge full moon. The setting consists of ancient Chinese-style palace architecture, giant vermilion columns, golden dougong brackets, upturned eaves, and suspended white drapery. A deep-blue sea of clouds and starry sky are visible in the distance.

[Visual style] 24fps, 8K ultra-high-definition, photorealistic next-generation 3D CG rendering, PBR physical materials, Lumen global illumination, volumetric lighting, dynamic motion blur, natural depth of field, cinematic high-contrast lighting, clean image with no noise. Premium new-Chinese xianxia aesthetic, UE5 cinematic rendering, cool blue moonlit ambient light contrasted against warm golden sparks, golden dark patterns, and sword-energy particles. Large areas of shadow, minimalist negative space, expressive ink-wash texture, cinematic 2.39:1 widescreen frame. Epic, cold, solitary, ethereal, and intensely exhilarating.

[Core visual effects] Black ink, golden fire, cyan-white sword energy, golden ember particles, fluid ink trailing, circular energy trajectories, crescent-shaped sword energy, and ink shockwaves. The fluid light trails contain fine floating debris and star-like particles, with soft glowing edges. Their motion remains smooth, continuous, and free of broken trailing artifacts. All destruction follows physical feedback: curtains torn by sword energy produce irregular frayed edges and fragments; wooden planks crack and splinter; ink and water spread outward after impact.

[Most important camera rules] A 30-second single take with only one camera. Absolutely no cuts, hard cuts, white flashes, black frames, jump transitions, teleportation, or reframing. All changes in framing and camera angle are completed through continuous movement by the same camera. Foreground white drapery, ink, water, and high-speed particles may only act as occlusion transitions within the same shot. When the occlusion ends, the camera must remain in the same time, motion direction, and spatial position. Camera movement is silky and steady, with subtle realistic impact vibrations at each footstep, landing, sword swing, and strike point. No random shake or loss of visual control.

Storyboard prompt

Shot 1: Complete single-take xianxia sword dance, 0s-30s

0s-2.5s: Distant opening, slow push-in

A wide low-angle horizontal shot. The camera begins about 20 meters behind the female protagonist, slowly pushing forward along the centerline of a dark wooden walkway. She faces away from the camera beneath a huge full moon, tiny as a speck of dust, her dark silhouette sharply outlined by moonlight.

She begins walking forward very slowly, arms naturally at her sides, then gradually tightens her right hand around a longsword. Her long hair and wide sleeves blow backward in the night wind; her white skirt floats slowly in a slightly low-gravity atmosphere. Each step lands about 1.5 seconds apart. The camera has approximately two pixels of vertical bounce and an extremely slight side-to-side shift, creating a realistic handheld-following feeling.

The reflective ground beneath her mirrors the full moon, her silhouette, and blurred reflections of distant golden palace structures. White hanging curtains sway slowly in the distance. The space is quiet, with only wind, moving mist, and the sound of fabric rubbing.

2.5s-5s: Forward lean, rapid sprint to the right

The same continuous camera path smoothly shifts from directly behind her toward her right-front side while accelerating forward. She suddenly leans forward, lowers her center of gravity, and sprints at high speed toward the right side of the frame.

Her right foot strikes the ground hard, creating fine cracks and splinters in the wooden planks. Her blue-black robe, long hair, and wide sleeves are violently pulled backward by acceleration. Her white skirt leaves a long mixed trail of golden fire and black ink, skimming over the reflective ground and leaving a clear reflection.

The camera develops subtle dynamic vibration in response to her acceleration, while she remains sharp and the background architecture gains strong motion parallax.

5s-7.5s: High-speed sword swing, tearing the first white curtain

She charges toward a huge white hanging curtain in the right foreground. The camera stays at her right-front side, matching her speed in a side-front tracking shot, lowered slightly for a medium low-angle view.

Without stopping her sprint, she draws her sword and completes one broad horizontal slash from back to front. The sword cuts through the air and releases a cyan-white sword-energy arc edged with gold.

The sword energy strikes the white curtain. The fabric first dents inward, then tears outward from the point of impact. It produces irregular frayed edges, scattered threads, and many fragments. White fabric scraps are pulled toward the lens by the airflow, creating natural foreground occlusion. The camera does not cut and continues following her through the dispersing fragments.

7.5s-10s: Midair rotation, circular sword energy forms

After passing through the white fabric debris, the camera continues moving toward the right-front and performs a smooth, small-radius orbit around her without abruptly changing direction.

Using the momentum of her sprint, she leaps into the air. Both feet leave the walkway as her body spins rapidly around its vertical axis. She first pulls in her arms, then extends her wide sleeves with the rotation. Her black hair forms an elegant arc and her skirt blooms outward like ink-wash petals.

The sword continuously moves with her body, forming a huge circular energy trajectory in front of her, interwoven with gold-white and cyan light. Inside the ring are ink diffusion, golden sparks, fine floating particles, and soft glowing edges. The circular sword energy sweeps over the ground, creating a bright circular reflection on the reflective surface below.

10s-12.5s: Rising before the moon, continuous crescent sword-energy strikes

The camera naturally rises with her rotation, shifting from a medium shot into a wide low-angle view. She forms a dark silhouette before the huge full moon. Crisp rim light outlines her hair, sword blade, and skirt in cold blue moonlight.

Holding the sword with both hands, she performs three violent continuous sword swings in midair:

First, a horizontal slash releases a cyan-white crescent-shaped sword energy arc.

Second, an upward diagonal slash tears through mist with its rising energy trail.

Third, a turning backhand slash releases a larger gold-and-cyan interwoven sword arc.

There can be no pause between the attacks. Her body rotation, shoulder force, waist twist, sleeve delay, and sword-energy release must form one complete causal chain. The energy passes beside her body, carrying black ink and golden sparks.

12.5s-15s: Sword energy cuts through space, camera follows the attack path

The camera briefly locks onto the sword tip, then rapidly pushes forward along the direction of the sword energy while remaining spatially connected to her. The energy cuts through several white hanging curtains ahead, slicing them in sequence and creating a shattered corridor from foreground into the distance.

White fabric fragments, gray ink, golden sparks, and cyan-white sword energy fly across the lens in intersecting paths, creating strong radial motion blur. The image can be briefly occluded by fast-moving debris, but it must never become a black frame or a cut. The camera rediscovers her silhouette through openings in the debris.

15s-18s: Diving close, downward sword strike

She draws the sword back in midair to gather power, then rapidly flips downward. From directly in front and below her, the camera quickly rises toward her and then dives downward in sync with her falling path, creating a close diving push-in and small-radius orbit.

Holding the sword in both hands, its blade gathers intense blue-white flame. She completes one heavy downward strike. The air around the impact point compresses into visible circular shock patterns, while the full moon's rim light passes from behind her to create an extremely strong black silhouette.

The sword energy strikes the dark wooden walkway. Mist is instantly pushed away by the shockwave, forming a brief low-pressure vacuum while surrounding water vapor bursts outward.

18s-21s: Landing impact, eruption of ink and water

The camera continues descending with her, shifting slightly to the side just before she lands so both the character and impact point remain fully visible.

She lands heavily on the dark wooden walkway, bending one knee slightly, with the sword embedded in the ground or angled forward. The impact cracks the wooden planks outward from beneath her feet. Wood splinters, stone fragments, and droplets spray along the cracks.

At the same time, enormous white waves and black ink surge upward from both sides of her body, forming exaggerated arcing waves. The waves contain fragments of golden firelight and cyan sword-energy particles, curling outward on both sides while preserving her dark silhouette at the center.

The camera receives one short impact vibration, then immediately returns to smooth tracking. No freeze frame.

21s-23s: Ink occlusion transition, continuous entry into the second spatial layer

The water and ink rush toward the lens. White, gray, and black fluid gradually covers the frame. The camera maintains an upward tilt and slight backward movement, using this fluid occlusion

es.content:
Descripción general

[Character] Una protagonista femenina. Su apariencia, vestuario y silueta deben coincidir estrictamente con la referencia de la protagonista femenina. Es una espadachina xianxia de estilo chino nuevo y oscuro, con el pelo largo, túnicas de mangas anchas y una amplia falda fluida. Siempre está retroiluminada por una enorme luna llena, permaneciendo como una silueta oscura sin un rostro frontal iluminado. No cambies el color del vestuario ni la silueta.

[Setting] Palacio celestial iluminado por la luna, pasarelas de madera oscura, tejados de tejas oscuras, cortinas blancas colgantes, suelo reflectante, mar de nubes, cielo nocturno profundo y una enorme luna llena. El entorno está compuesto por arquitectura palaciega de estilo chino antiguo, gigantescas columnas bermellón, soportes dougong dorados, aleros curvados hacia arriba y drapeados blancos suspendidos. A lo lejos se ven un mar de nubes azul profundo y un cielo estrellado.

[Visual style] 24fps, 8K ultra-high-definition, photorealistic next-generation 3D CG rendering, PBR physical materials, Lumen global illumination, volumetric lighting, dynamic motion blur, natural depth of field, cinematic high-contrast lighting, clean image with no noise. Premium new-Chinese xianxia aesthetic, UE5 cinematic rendering, cool blue moonlit ambient light contrasted against warm golden sparks, golden dark patterns, and sword-energy particles. Large areas of shadow, minimalist negative space, expressive ink-wash texture, cinematic 2.39:1 widescreen frame. Epic, cold, solitary, ethereal, and intensely exhilarating.

[Core visual effects] Black ink, golden fire, cyan-white sword energy, golden ember particles, fluid ink trailing, circular energy trajectories, crescent-shaped sword energy, and ink shockwaves. The fluid light trails contain fine floating debris and star-like particles, with soft glowing edges. Their motion remains smooth, continuous, and free of broken trailing artifacts. All destruction follows physical feedback: curtains torn by sword energy produce irregular frayed edges and fragments; wooden planks crack and splinter; ink and water spread outward after impact.

[Most important camera rules] A 30-second single take with only one camera. Absolutely no cuts, hard cuts, white flashes, black frames, jump transitions, teleportation, or reframing. All changes in framing and camera angle are completed through continuous movement by the same camera. Foreground white drapery, ink, water, and high-speed particles may only act as occlusion transitions within the same shot. When the occlusion ends, the camera must remain in the same time, motion direction, and spatial position. Camera movement is silky and steady, with subtle realistic impact vibrations at each footstep, landing, sword swing, and strike point. No random shake or loss of visual control.

Storyboard prompt

Shot 1: Complete single-take xianxia sword dance, 0s-30s

0s-2.5s: Apertura lejana, avance lento

Un plano horizontal amplio y bajo. La cámara comienza a unos 20 metros detrás de la protagonista femenina y avanza lentamente por la línea central de una pasarela de madera oscura. Ella mira en dirección opuesta a la cámara bajo una enorme luna llena, diminuta como un grano de polvo, con su silueta oscura recortada con nitidez por la luz de la luna.

Empieza a caminar muy despacio hacia delante, con los brazos relajados a los lados, y luego aprieta gradualmente la mano derecha alrededor de una espada larga. Su pelo largo y sus mangas anchas se agitan hacia atrás con el viento nocturno; su falda blanca flota lentamente en una atmósfera de gravedad ligeramente reducida. Cada paso cae aproximadamente cada 1,5 segundos. La cámara tiene alrededor de dos píxeles de rebote vertical y un desplazamiento lateral extremadamente sutil, creando una sensación realista de seguimiento a mano.

El suelo reflectante bajo ella refleja la luna llena, su silueta y los reflejos desenfocados de las estructuras palaciegas doradas del fondo. Las cortinas blancas colgantes se mecen lentamente a lo lejos. El espacio es silencioso, con solo el viento, la niebla en movimiento y el sonido del roce de la tela.

2.5s-5s: Inclinación hacia delante, sprint rápido hacia la derecha

La misma trayectoria continua de cámara se desplaza suavemente desde justo detrás de ella hacia su lado frontal derecho mientras acelera hacia delante. De repente se inclina hacia delante, baja su centro de gravedad y corre a gran velocidad hacia el lado derecho del encuadre.

Su pie derecho golpea con fuerza el suelo, creando finas grietas y astillas en las tablas de madera. Su túnica azul-negra, su pelo largo y sus mangas anchas son arrastrados violentamente hacia atrás por la aceleración. Su falda blanca deja una larga estela mixta de fuego dorado y tinta negra, rozando el suelo reflectante y dejando un reflejo nítido.

La cámara desarrolla una sutil vibración dinámica en respuesta a su aceleración, mientras ella permanece nítida y la arquitectura del fondo gana un fuerte paralaje de movimiento.

5s-7.5s: Golpe de espada a alta velocidad, rasgando la primera cortina blanca

Se lanza hacia una enorme cortina blanca colgante en el primer plano derecho. La cámara se mantiene en su lado frontal derecho, igualando su velocidad en un plano de seguimiento lateral-frontal, ligeramente rebajado para una vista en ligero contrapicado medio.

Sin detener su carrera, desenvaina la espada y completa un amplio tajo horizontal de atrás hacia delante. La espada corta el aire y libera un arco de energía de espada cian-blanco bordeado de oro.

La energía de la espada impacta contra la cortina blanca. La tela primero se hunde hacia dentro y luego se desgarra hacia fuera desde el punto de impacto. Produce bordes irregulares y deshilachados, hilos dispersos y muchos fragmentos. Los restos de tela blanca son arrastrados hacia el objetivo por el flujo de aire, creando una oclusión natural en primer plano. La cámara no corta y continúa siguiéndola a través de los fragmentos que se dispersan.

7.5s-10s: Rotación en el aire, se forma energía circular de espada

Después de atravesar los restos de tela blanca, la cámara continúa moviéndose hacia el frente derecho y realiza una pequeña órbita suave a su alrededor sin cambiar bruscamente de dirección.

Usando el impulso de su carrera, salta al aire. Ambos pies abandonan la pasarela mientras su cuerpo gira rápidamente alrededor de su eje vertical. Primero recoge los brazos y luego extiende sus mangas anchas con la rotación. Su cabello negro forma un arco elegante y su falda se abre hacia afuera como pétalos de tinta.

La espada se mueve continuamente con su cuerpo, formando una enorme trayectoria circular de energía frente a ella, entrelazada con luz dorada-blanca y cian. Dentro del anillo hay difusión de tinta, chispas doradas, partículas finas flotantes y bordes suaves y luminosos. La energía circular de la espada barre el suelo, creando un brillante reflejo circular sobre la superficie reflectante inferior.

10s-12.5s: Elevándose ante la luna, golpes continuos de energía de espada en forma de media luna

La cámara asciende de forma natural con su rotación, pasando de un plano medio a una vista amplia en contrapicado. Ella forma una silueta oscura frente a la enorme luna llena. Una luz de contorno nítida perfila su cabello, la hoja de la espada y la falda con la fría luz azul de la luna.

Sosteniendo la espada con ambas manos, realiza tres violentos y continuos golpes de espada en el aire:

Primero, un tajo horizontal libera un arco de energía de espada en forma de media luna cian-blanco.

Segundo, un tajo diagonal ascendente rasga la niebla con su estela de energía ascendente.

Tercero, un tajo invertido de revés libera un arco de espada más grande entrelazado en oro y cian.

No puede haber pausa entre los ataques. La rotación de su cuerpo, la fuerza de los hombros, la torsión de la cintura, el retraso de las mangas y la liberación de la energía de espada deben formar una única cadena causal completa. La energía pasa junto a su cuerpo, llevando tinta negra y chispas doradas.

12.5s-15s: La energía de espada corta el espacio, la cámara sigue la trayectoria del ataque

La cámara se fija brevemente en la punta de la espada y luego avanza rápidamente en la dirección de la energía de la espada, manteniéndose espacialmente conectada a ella. La energía corta varias cortinas blancas colgantes que tiene delante, partiéndolas en secuencia y creando un corredor destrozado desde el primer plano hasta la distancia.

Fragmentos de tela blanca, tinta gris, chispas doradas y energía de espada cian-blanco cruzan el objetivo en trayectorias que se intersectan, creando un fuerte desenfoque radial por movimiento. La imagen puede quedar brevemente ocluida por escombros que se mueven a gran velocidad, pero nunca debe convertirse en un fotograma negro ni en un corte.

fr.content:
---
Description générale

[Character] Une protagoniste féminine. Son apparence, son costume et sa silhouette doivent correspondre strictement à la référence de la protagoniste féminine. C’est une épéiste xianxia de style nouveau-chinois, sombre, avec de longs cheveux, des robes à larges manches et une large jupe fluide. Elle est toujours rétroéclairée par une immense pleine lune, restant une silhouette sombre sans visage frontal éclairé de manière vive. Ne modifiez ni la couleur du costume ni la silhouette.

[Setting] Palais céleste baigné de clair de lune, passerelles en bois sombre, toits en tuiles sombres, rideaux blancs suspendus, sol réfléchissant, mer de nuages, ciel nocturne profond et immense pleine lune. Le décor se compose d’une architecture de palais chinois ancien, de gigantesques colonnes vermillon, de dougong dorés, d’avant-toits relevés et de draperies blanches suspendues. Une mer de nuages bleu profond et un ciel étoilé sont visibles au loin.

[Visual style] 24 fps, 8K ultra-haute définition, rendu 3D CG photoréaliste de nouvelle génération, matériaux physiques PBR, illumination globale Lumen, éclairage volumétrique, motion blur dynamique, profondeur de champ naturelle, éclairage cinématographique à fort contraste, image propre sans bruit. Esthétique premium xianxia de style nouveau-chinois, rendu cinématographique UE5, lumière ambiante froide de clair de lune contrastant avec des étincelles dorées chaudes, motifs sombres dorés et particules d’énergie d’épée. Grandes zones d’ombre, espace négatif minimaliste, texture expressive à l’encre, cadre cinématographique grand écran 2.39:1. Épique, froid, solitaire, éthéré et intensément exaltant.

[Core visual effects] Encre noire, feu doré, énergie d’épée cyan-blanc, particules de braises dorées, traînées fluides d’encre, trajectoires circulaires d’énergie, énergie d’épée en forme de croissant et ondes de choc d’encre. Les traînées lumineuses fluides contiennent de fins débris flottants et des particules semblables à des étoiles, avec des bords doux et lumineux. Leur mouvement reste fluide, continu et exempt d’artefacts de traînée cassée. Toute destruction suit un retour physique : les rideaux déchirés par l’énergie de l’épée produisent des bords irréguliers effilochés et des fragments ; les planches de bois se fissurent et se fendent ; l’encre et l’eau se répandent vers l’extérieur après l’impact.

[Most important camera rules] Un plan-séquence unique de 30 secondes avec une seule caméra. Absolument aucune coupe, coupe franche, flash blanc, cadre noir, transition par saut, téléportation ou recadrage. Tous les changements de cadrage et d’angle de caméra doivent être réalisés par un mouvement continu de la même caméra. Les rideaux blancs au premier plan, l’encre, l’eau et les particules à grande vitesse ne peuvent servir que de transitions par occultation au sein du même plan. Lorsque l’occultation se termine, la caméra doit rester dans le même temps, la même direction de mouvement et la même position spatiale. Le mouvement de caméra est soyeux et stable, avec de subtiles vibrations réalistes à chaque pas, atterrissage, coup d’épée et point d’impact. Aucun tremblement aléatoire ni perte de contrôle visuel.

Storyboard prompt

Shot 1: Complete single-take xianxia sword dance, 0s-30s

0s-2.5s: Distant opening, slow push-in

Un plan large horizontal en légère contre-plongée. La caméra commence à environ 20 mètres derrière la protagoniste féminine et avance lentement le long de l’axe central d’une passerelle en bois sombre. Elle fait face à l’opposé de la caméra sous une immense pleine lune, minuscule comme un grain de poussière, sa silhouette sombre nettement découpée par le clair de lune.

Elle commence à marcher très lentement vers l’avant, les bras naturellement le long du corps, puis serre progressivement la poignée d’une longue épée dans sa main droite. Ses longs cheveux et ses larges manches sont repoussés vers l’arrière par le vent nocturne ; sa jupe blanche flotte lentement dans une atmosphère légèrement en faible gravité. Chaque pas se pose à environ 1,5 seconde d’intervalle. La caméra présente environ deux pixels de rebond vertical et un très léger décalage latéral, créant une sensation réaliste de suivi à main levée.

Le sol réfléchissant sous elle renvoie la pleine lune, sa silhouette et les reflets flous des structures dorées du palais au loin. Des rideaux blancs suspendus ondulent lentement à distance. L’espace est silencieux, avec seulement le vent, la brume en mouvement et le froissement du tissu.

2.5s-5s: Forward lean, rapid sprint to the right

Le même trajet de caméra continu se déplace en douceur de l’arrière direct vers son côté avant droit tout en accélérant vers l’avant. Elle se penche soudainement en avant, abaisse son centre de gravité et sprinte à grande vitesse vers la droite du cadre.

Son pied droit frappe le sol avec force, créant de fines fissures et des éclats dans les planches de bois. Sa robe bleu-noir, ses longs cheveux et ses larges manches sont violemment tirés vers l’arrière par l’accélération. Sa jupe blanche laisse une longue traînée mêlée de feu doré et d’encre noire, glissant sur le sol réfléchissant et y laissant un reflet net.

La caméra développe une subtile vibration dynamique en réponse à son accélération, tandis qu’elle reste nette et que l’architecture de fond gagne un fort parallaxe de mouvement.

5s-7.5s: High-speed sword swing, tearing the first white curtain

Elle fonce vers un immense rideau blanc suspendu au premier plan droit. La caméra reste à son côté avant droit, suivant sa vitesse dans un plan de suivi latéral avant, légèrement abaissé pour une vue en légère contre-plongée moyenne.

Sans interrompre sa course, elle dégaine son épée et exécute une large coupe horizontale de l’arrière vers l’avant. L’épée fend l’air et libère un arc d’énergie d’épée cyan-blanc bordé d’or.

L’énergie d’épée frappe le rideau blanc. Le tissu se creuse d’abord vers l’intérieur, puis se déchire vers l’extérieur à partir du point d’impact. Cela produit des bords irréguliers effilochés, des fils dispersés et de nombreux fragments. Des lambeaux de tissu blanc sont aspirés vers l’objectif par le flux d’air, créant une occultation naturelle du premier plan. La caméra ne coupe pas et continue de la suivre à travers les fragments qui se dispersent.

7.5s-10s: Midair rotation, circular sword energy forms

Après avoir traversé les débris du tissu blanc, la caméra continue de se déplacer vers l’avant droit et effectue une petite orbite fluide autour d’elle sans changer brusquement de direction.

En utilisant l’élan de sa course, elle saute dans les airs. Ses deux pieds quittent la passerelle tandis que son corps tourne rapidement autour de son axe vertical. Elle ramène d’abord ses bras, puis déploie ses larges manches avec la rotation. Ses cheveux noirs dessinent une arche élégante et sa jupe s’épanouit comme des pétales d’encre.

L’épée accompagne continuellement son corps, formant devant elle une immense trajectoire circulaire d’énergie, entrelacée de lumière or-blanc et cyan. À l’intérieur de l’anneau se trouvent une diffusion d’encre, des étincelles dorées, de fines particules flottantes et des bords lumineux doux. L’énergie circulaire de l’épée balaie le sol, créant un reflet circulaire lumineux sur la surface réfléchissante en dessous.

10s-12.5s: Rising before the moon, continuous crescent sword-energy strikes

La caméra s’élève naturellement avec sa rotation, passant d’un plan moyen à une large vue en légère contre-plongée. Elle forme une silhouette sombre devant l’immense pleine lune. Un contour net dessine ses cheveux, la lame de son épée et sa jupe dans la froide lumière bleue du clair de lune.

Tenant l’épée à deux mains, elle exécute trois violentes coupes continues dans les airs :

First, a horizontal slash releases a cyan-white crescent-shaped sword energy arc.

Second, an upward diagonal slash tears through mist with its rising energy trail.

Third, a turning backhand slash releases a larger gold-and-cyan interwoven sword arc.

Il ne peut y avoir aucune pause entre les attaques. La rotation de son corps, la force des épaules, la torsion de la taille, le retard des manches et la libération de l’énergie d’épée doivent former une chaîne causale complète. L’énergie passe à côté de son corps, emportant encre noire et étincelles dorées.

12.5s-15s: Sword energy cuts through space, camera follows the attack path

ja.content:
---
全体説明

[Character] 女性主人公。彼女の外見、衣装、シルエットは、女性主人公の参照と厳密に一致していなければならない。彼女は、長髪、広袖のローブ、そして大きく流れるようなスカートをまとった、ダークな新中華風の仙侠剣士である。常に巨大な満月を背に受けて逆光になっており、明るく照らされた正面の顔は見えない暗いシルエットのままである。衣装の色やシルエットは変更しないこと。

[Setting] 月明かりに照らされた天上の宮殿、暗い木製の回廊、暗い瓦屋根、垂れ下がる白いカーテン、反射する地面、雲海、深い夜空、そして巨大な満月。舞台は古代中国風の宮殿建築で構成され、巨大な朱色の柱、金色の斗拱、反り上がった軒、吊り下げられた白い布飾りがある。遠景には深い青の雲海と星空が見える。

[Visual style] 24fps、8K超高精細、フォトリアルな次世代3D CGレンダリング、PBR物理マテリアル、Lumenグローバルイルミネーション、ボリューメトリックライティング、ダイナミックモーションブラー、自然な被写界深度、シネマティックな高コントラスト照明、ノイズのないクリーンな映像。上質な新中華風仙侠美学、UE5シネマティックレンダリング、冷たい青い月光の環境光と、温かい金色の火花、金色の暗紋、剣気の粒子との対比。大きな影の面、ミニマルなネガティブスペース、表現的な水墨テクスチャ、シネマティックな2.39:1ワイドスクリーンフレーム。壮大で、冷たく、孤独で、幽玄であり、強烈に高揚感のある雰囲気。

[Core visual effects] 黒い墨、金色の炎、シアンホワイトの剣気、金色の火の粉、流れるような墨の軌跡、円形のエネルギー軌道、三日月形の剣気、そして墨の衝撃波。流体の光跡には、微細な浮遊破片と星のような粒子が含まれ、柔らかく発光する縁を持つ。その動きは滑らかで連続的であり、途切れた軌跡のアーティファクトはないこと。破壊表現はすべて物理的なフィードバックに従うこと。剣気で引き裂かれたカーテンは不規則なほつれた縁と断片を生み、木の板はひび割れて裂け、墨と水は衝撃後に外側へ広がる。

[Most important camera rules] 30秒のワンテイクで、カメラは1台のみ。カット、ハードカット、白フラッシュ、黒フレーム、ジャンプトランジション、テレポーテーション、リフレーミングは絶対に不可。フレーミングやカメラアングルの変化は、すべて同じカメラの連続した動きによって完了すること。前景の白い布、墨、水、高速粒子は、同一ショット内でのオクルージョン遷移としてのみ機能してよい。オクルージョンが終わった後も、カメラは同じ時間、同じ移動方向、同じ空間的位置を保たなければならない。カメラの動きは絹のように滑らかで安定しており、足音、着地、剣の振り、打撃点ごとに、わずかでリアルな衝撃振動があること。ランダムな揺れや視覚制御の喪失は不可。

Storyboard prompt

Shot 1: Complete single-take xianxia sword dance, 0s-30s

0s-2.5s: Distant opening, slow push-in

広角のローアングル横構図。カメラは女性主人公の約20メートル後方から始まり、暗い木製回廊の中心線に沿ってゆっくり前進する。彼女は巨大な満月の下でカメラに背を向け、塵のように小さく見え、月光によって暗いシルエットがくっきりと縁取られている。

彼女は非常にゆっくりと前へ歩き始め、腕は自然に体の両側へ下ろしているが、やがて右手で長剣をしっかりと握り締める。長い髪と広い袖は夜風に後方へなびき、白いスカートはやや低重力のような空気の中でゆっくりと漂う。各ステップの間隔は約1.5秒。カメラには上下約2ピクセルの揺れと、ごくわずかな左右のブレがあり、リアルな手持ち追従感を生み出す。

彼女の下の反射する地面には、満月、彼女のシルエット、そして遠くの金色の宮殿建築のぼやけた反射が映る。白い吊りカーテンが遠景でゆっくり揺れる。空間は静かで、聞こえるのは風、動く霧、布が擦れる音だけ。

2.5s-5s: Forward lean, rapid sprint to the right

同じ連続したカメラ軌道が、彼女の真後ろから右前方へと滑らかに移りつつ、前進速度を上げる。彼女は突然前傾し、重心を下げ、フレーム右側へ高速で疾走する。

右足が地面を強く踏みつけ、木の板に細かなひびとささくれを生む。青黒いローブ、長い髪、広い袖は加速によって激しく後方へ引かれる。白いスカートは金色の炎と黒い墨が混ざった長い軌跡を残し、反射する地面の上をかすめながら、はっきりとした反射像を残す。

彼女の加速に応じてカメラには微細なダイナミック振動が生じる一方、彼女は鮮明に保たれ、背景建築には強いモーションパララックスが現れる。

5s-7.5s: High-speed sword swing, tearing the first white curtain

彼女は右前景の巨大な白い吊りカーテンへ向かって突進する。カメラは彼女の右前方に位置したまま、速度を合わせるようにやや低めのサイドフロント追従ショットとなり、中程度のローアングルで捉える。

疾走を止めることなく、彼女は剣を抜き、後方から前方へ向かう大きな水平斬りを一度だけ完了する。剣は空気を切り裂き、金縁のシアンホワイトの剣気アークを放つ。

剣気は白いカーテンに命中する。布はまず内側へへこみ、その後、衝撃点から外側へ裂ける。不規則なほつれた縁、飛び散る糸、多数の断片が生じる。白い布片は気流に押されてレンズ方向へ引き寄せられ、自然な前景オクルージョンを作る。カメラはカットせず、散っていく破片の中をそのまま彼女を追い続ける。

ko.content:
---
전체 설명

[Character] 여성 주인공. 그녀의 외형, 의상, 실루엣은 반드시 여성 주인공 레퍼런스와 엄격히 일치해야 한다. 그녀는 긴 머리, 넓은 소매의 로브, 넓게 퍼지는 치마를 입은 다크한 뉴 차이니즈 스타일의 선협 검객이다. 항상 거대한 보름달의 역광을 받아, 밝게 비친 정면 얼굴 없이 어두운 실루엣으로 남아 있어야 한다. 의상 색상이나 실루엣을 변경하지 마라.

[Setting] 달빛이 비추는 천상 궁전, 어두운 목재 회랑, 어두운 기와지붕, 매달린 흰 커튼, 반사되는 바닥, 운해, 깊은 밤하늘, 그리고 거대한 보름달. 배경은 고대 중국식 궁궐 건축으로 이루어져 있으며, 거대한 주홍색 기둥, 황금색 dougong 브래킷, 처마가 위로 들린 지붕선, 매달린 흰 드레이프가 포함된다. 멀리에는 짙은 푸른색의 운해와 별이 빛나는 하늘이 보인다.

[Visual style] 24fps, 8K 초고해상도, 포토리얼한 차세대 3D CG 렌더링, PBR 물리 기반 재질, Lumen 글로벌 일루미네이션, 볼류메트릭 라이팅, 다이내믹 모션 블러, 자연스러운 심도, 시네마틱한 고대비 조명, 노이즈 없는 깨끗한 이미지. 프리미엄 뉴 차이니즈 선협 미학, UE5 시네마틱 렌더링, 차가운 푸른 달빛의 주변광과 따뜻한 황금빛 스파크, 황금색 어두운 패턴, 검기 입자의 대비. 넓은 그림자 영역, 미니멀한 네거티브 스페이스, 표현적인 수묵 질감, 시네마틱 2.39:1 와이드스크린 프레임. 장엄하고, 차갑고, 고독하며, 초현실적이고, 강렬하게 짜릿한 분위기.

[Core visual effects] 검은 먹, 황금빛 불꽃, 청백색 검기, 황금색 불씨 입자, 유동적인 먹의 잔흔, 원형 에너지 궤적, 초승달 형태의 검기, 그리고 먹의 충격파. 유동적인 빛의 궤적에는 미세하게 떠다니는 잔해와 별빛 같은 입자가 포함되며, 가장자리는 부드럽게 빛난다. 움직임은 매끄럽고 연속적이어야 하며, 끊어진 잔상 아티팩트가 없어야 한다. 모든 파괴는 물리적 피드백을 따라야 한다: 검기에 찢긴 커튼은 불규칙한 해진 가장자리와 파편을 만들고, 목재 판자는 금이 가고 부서지며, 먹과 물은 충돌 후 바깥으로 퍼져나간다.

[Most important camera rules] 30초짜리 단일 테이크, 카메라는 하나만 사용한다. 절대 컷, 하드 컷, 흰색 플래시, 검은 프레임, 점프 전환, 텔레포테이션, 리프레이밍이 있어서는 안 된다. 구도와 카메라 각도의 모든 변화는 동일한 카메라의 연속적인 움직임으로만 완성되어야 한다. 전경의 흰 드레이프, 먹, 물, 고속 입자는 같은 샷 안에서만 가림 전환(occlusion transition) 역할을 할 수 있다. 가림이 끝나면 카메라는 같은 시간, 같은 움직임 방향, 같은 공간적 위치를 유지해야 한다. 카메라 움직임은 실크처럼 부드럽고 안정적이어야 하며, 발걸음, 착지, 검 휘두름, 타격 지점마다 미세하고 사실적인 충격 진동이 있어야 한다. 무작위 흔들림이나 시각적 제어 상실은 없어야 한다.

스토리보드 프롬프트

Shot 1: 완전한 단일 테이크 선협 검무, 0s-30s

0s-2.5s: 먼 거리 오프닝, 느린 푸시인

넓은 로우 앵글 수평 샷. 카메라는 여성 주인공의 약 20미터 뒤에서 시작해, 어두운 목재 회랑의 중심선을 따라 천천히 전진한다. 그녀는 거대한 보름달 아래에서 카메라에 등을 돌린 채 서 있으며, 먼지 한 톨처럼 작게 보이지만 달빛에 의해 어두운 실루엣이 선명하게 드러난다.

그녀는 매우 천천히 앞으로 걷기 시작하고, 양팔은 자연스럽게 옆에 둔 채 있다가 점차 오른손으로 장검을 단단히 쥔다. 긴 머리와 넓은 소매는 밤바람에 뒤로 휘날리고, 흰 치마는 약간 낮은 중력의 분위기 속에서 천천히 떠오른다. 각 발걸음은 약 1.5초 간격으로 내려앉는다. 카메라는 수직으로 약 2픽셀 정도의 미세한 바운스와 극히 약한 좌우 흔들림을 가지며, 사실적인 핸드헬드 추적 느낌을 만든다.

그녀 아래의 반사되는 바닥은 보름달, 그녀의 실루엣, 그리고 멀리 있는 황금빛 궁궐 구조물의 흐릿한 반영을 비춘다. 멀리서는 흰색 매달린 커튼이 천천히 흔들린다. 공간은 고요하며, 바람과 움직이는 안개, 그리고 천이 스치는 소리만 들린다.

2.5s-5s: 몸을 앞으로 기울이며, 오른쪽으로 빠르게 질주

같은 연속적인 카메라 경로가 그녀의 정면 뒤쪽에서 오른쪽 앞쪽으로 부드럽게 이동하면서 속도를 높인다. 그녀는 갑자기 몸을 앞으로 숙이고 중심을 낮춘 뒤, 프레임의 오른쪽을 향해 고속으로 질주한다.

오른발이 바닥을 세게 딛는 순간 목재 판자에 미세한 균열과 파편이 생긴다. 그녀의 청흑색 로브, 긴 머리, 넓은 소매는 가속에 의해 거세게 뒤로 끌려간다. 흰 치마는 황금빛 불꽃과 검은 먹이 섞인 긴 흔적을 남기며 반사되는 바닥 위를 스치고 지나가고, 그 반영도 선명하게 남는다.

카메라는 그녀의 가속에 반응해 미세한 다이내믹 진동을 보이지만, 그녀는 선명하게 유지되고 배경 건축물은 강한 모션 패럴랙스를 드러낸다.

5s-7.5s: 고속 검 휘두름, 첫 번째 흰 커튼을 찢음

그녀는 오른쪽 전경에 있는 거대한 흰색 매달린 커튼을 향해 돌진한다. 카메라는 그녀의 오른쪽 앞쪽에 머물며 속도를 맞춘 채, 약간 낮은 위치에서 중간 로우 앵글의 사이드-프론트 트래킹 샷을 유지한다.

멈추지 않고 그녀는 검을 뽑아 등 뒤에서 앞으로 이어지는 넓은 수평 베기를 한 번 완성한다. 검은 공기를 가르며 가장자리에 금빛이 둘린 청백색 검기 호를 방출한다.

검기는 흰 커튼을 강타한다. 천은 먼저 안쪽으로 움푹 들어갔다가, 충돌 지점에서 바깥쪽으로 찢어진다. 불규칙한 해진 가장자리, 흩어진 실, 많은 파편이 생긴다. 흰 천 조각들이 공기 흐름에 의해 렌즈 쪽으로 끌려오며 자연스러운 전경 가림을 만든다. 카메라는 컷 없이 계속해서 흩어지는 파편 사이로 그녀를 따라간다.

7.5s-10s: 공중 회전, 원형 검기 형성

흰 천 파편을 통과한 뒤에도 카메라는 계속 오른쪽 앞쪽으로 이동하며, 급격한 방향 전환 없이 그녀를 중심으로 부드럽고 작은 반경의 오비트를 수행한다.

---
Descrição geral

[Character] Uma protagonista feminina. Sua aparência, figurino e silhueta devem corresponder estritamente à referência da protagonista feminina. Ela é uma espadachim xianxia de estilo chinês novo, em tons escuros, com cabelo longo, roupas de mangas largas e uma saia ampla e fluida. Ela está sempre em contraluz por uma enorme lua cheia, permanecendo uma silhueta escura, sem rosto frontal iluminado. Não altere a cor do figurino nem a silhueta.

[Setting] Palácio celestial iluminado pela lua, passarelas de madeira escura, telhados de telhas escuras, cortinas brancas pendentes, chão refletivo, mar de nuvens, céu noturno profundo e uma enorme lua cheia. O cenário é composto por arquitetura de palácio em estilo chinês antigo, colunas vermelhão gigantes, suportes dougong dourados, beirais curvados para cima e drapeados brancos suspensos. Um mar de nuvens azul-escuro e um céu estrelado são visíveis ao longe.

[Visual style] 24fps, 8K ultra-high-definition, photorealistic next-generation 3D CG rendering, PBR physical materials, Lumen global illumination, volumetric lighting, dynamic motion blur, natural depth of field, cinematic high-contrast lighting, clean image with no noise. Premium new-Chinese xianxia aesthetic, UE5 cinematic rendering, cool blue moonlit ambient light contrasted against warm golden sparks, golden dark patterns, and sword-energy particles. Large areas of shadow, minimalist negative space, expressive ink-wash texture, cinematic 2.39:1 widescreen frame. Epic, cold, solitary, ethereal, and intensely exhilarating.

[Core visual effects] Black ink, golden fire, cyan-white sword energy, golden ember particles, fluid ink trailing, circular energy trajectories, crescent-shaped sword energy, and ink shockwaves. The fluid light trails contain fine floating debris and star-like particles, with soft glowing edges. Their motion remains smooth, continuous, and free of broken trailing artifacts. All destruction follows physical feedback: curtains torn by sword energy produce irregular frayed edges and fragments; wooden planks crack and splinter; ink and water spread outward after impact.

[Most important camera rules] A 30-second single take with only one camera. Absolutely no cuts, hard cuts, white flashes, black frames, jump transitions, teleportation, or reframing. All changes in framing and camera angle are completed through continuous movement by the same camera. Foreground white drapery, ink, water, and high-speed particles may only act as occlusion transitions within the same shot. When the occlusion ends, the camera must remain in the same time, motion direction, and spatial position. Camera movement is silky and steady, with subtle realistic impact vibrations at each footstep, landing, sword swing, and strike point. No random shake or loss of visual control.

Storyboard prompt

Shot 1: Complete single-take xianxia sword dance, 0s-30s

0s-2.5s: Distant opening, slow push-in

A wide low-angle horizontal shot. The camera begins about 20 meters behind the female protagonist, slowly pushing forward along the centerline of a dark wooden walkway. She faces away from the camera beneath a huge full moon, tiny as a speck of dust, her dark silhouette sharply outlined by moonlight.

She begins walking forward very slowly, arms naturally at her sides, then gradually tightens her right hand around a longsword. Her long hair and wide sleeves blow backward in the night wind; her white skirt floats slowly in a slightly low-gravity atmosphere. Each step lands about 1.5 seconds apart. The camera has approximately two pixels of vertical bounce and an extremely slight side-to-side shift, creating a realistic handheld-following feeling.

The reflective ground beneath her mirrors the full moon, her silhouette, and blurred reflections of distant golden palace structures. White hanging curtains sway slowly in the distance. The space is quiet, with only wind, moving mist, and the sound of fabric rubbing.

2.5s-5s: Forward lean, rapid sprint to the right

The same continuous camera path smoothly shifts from directly behind her toward her right-front side while accelerating forward. She suddenly leans forward, lowers her center of gravity, and sprints at high speed toward the right side of the frame.

Her right foot strikes the ground hard, creating fine cracks and splinters in the wooden planks. Her blue-black robe, long hair, and wide sleeves are violently pulled backward by acceleration. Her white skirt leaves a long mixed trail of golden fire and black ink, skimming over the reflective ground and leaving a clear reflection.

The camera develops subtle dynamic vibration in response to her acceleration, while she remains sharp and the background architecture gains strong motion parallax.

5s-7.5s: High-speed sword swing, tearing the first white curtain

She charges toward a huge white hanging curtain in the right foreground. The camera stays at her right-front side, matching her speed in a side-front tracking shot, lowered slightly for a medium low-angle view.

Without stopping her sprint, she draws her sword and completes one broad horizontal slash from back to front. The sword cuts through the air and releases a cyan-white sword-energy arc edged with gold.

The sword energy strikes the white curtain. The fabric first dents inward, then tears outward from the point of impact. It produces irregular frayed edges, scattered threads, and many fragments. White fabric scraps are pulled toward the lens by the airflow, creating natural foreground occlusion. The camera does not cut and continues following her through the dispersing fragments.

7.5s-10s: Midair rotation, circular sword energy forms

After passing through the white fabric debris, the camera continues moving toward the right-front and performs a smooth, small-radius orbit around her without abruptly changing direction.

Using the momentum of her sprint, she leaps into the air. Both feet leave the walkway as her body spins rapidly around its vertical axis. She first pulls in her arms, then extends her wide sleeves with the rotation. Her black hair forms an elegant arc and her skirt blooms outward like ink-wash petals.

The sword continuously moves with her body, forming a huge circular energy trajectory in front of her, interwoven with gold-white and cyan light. Inside the ring are ink diffusion, golden sparks, fine floating particles, and soft glowing edges. The circular sword energy sweeps over the ground, creating a bright circular reflection on the reflective surface below.

10s-12.5s: Rising before the moon, continuous crescent sword-energy strikes

The camera naturally rises with her rotation, shifting from a medium shot into a wide low-angle view. She forms a dark silhouette before the huge full moon. Crisp rim light outlines her hair, sword blade, and skirt in cold blue moonlight.

Holding the sword with both hands, she performs three violent continuous sword swings in midair:

First, a horizontal slash releases a cyan-white crescent-shaped sword energy arc.

Second, an upward diagonal slash tears through mist with its rising energy trail.

Third, a turning backhand slash releases a larger gold-and-cyan interwoven sword arc.

There can be no pause between the attacks. Her body rotation, shoulder force, waist twist, sleeve delay, and sword-energy release must form one complete causal chain. The energy passes beside her body, carrying black ink and golden sparks.

12.5s-15s: Sword energy cuts through space, camera follows the attack path

The camera briefly locks onto the sword tip, then rapidly pushes forward along the direction of the sword energy while remaining spatially connected to her. The energy cuts through several white hanging curtains ahead, slicing them in sequence and creating a shattered corridor from foreground into the distance.

White fabric fragments, gray ink, golden sparks, and cyan-white sword energy fly across the lens in intersecting paths, creating strong radial motion blur. The image can be briefly occluded by fast-moving debris, but it must never become a black frame or a cut. The camera rediscovers her silhouette through openings in the debris.

15s-18s: Diving close, downward sword strike

She draws the sword back in midair to gather power, then rapidly flips downward. From directly in front and below her, the camera quickly rises toward her and then dives downward in sync with her falling path, creating a close diving push-in and small-radius orbit.

Holding the sword in both hands, its blade gathers intense blue-white flame. She completes one heavy downward strike. The air around the impact point compresses into visible circular shock patterns, while the full moon's rim light passes from behind her to create an extremely strong black silhouette.

The sword energy strikes the dark wooden walkway. Mist is instantly pushed away by the shockwave, forming a brief low-pressure vacuum while surrounding water vapor bursts outward.

18s-21s: Landing impact, eruption of ink and water

The camera continues descending with her, shifting slightly to the side just before she lands so both the character and impact point remain fully visible.

She lands heavily on the dark wooden walkway, bending one knee slightly, with the sword embedded in the ground or angled forward. The impact cracks the wooden planks outward from beneath her feet. Wood splinters, stone fragments, and droplets spray along the cracks.

At the same time, enormous white waves and black ink surge upward from both sides of her body, forming exaggerated arcing waves. The waves contain fragments of golden firelight and cyan sword-energy particles, curling outward on both sides while preserving her dark silhouette at the center.

The camera receives one short impact vibration, then immediately returns to smooth tracking. No freeze frame.

整体描述

[Character] 一位女性主角。她的外貌、服装和轮廓必须严格符合女性主角参考图。她是一名暗色新中式仙侠剑客，留着长发，身穿宽袖长袍和宽大飘逸的长裙。她始终被巨大的满月从背后逆光照亮，保持为没有正面亮面部的黑色剪影。不要改变服装颜色或轮廓。

[Setting] 月光下的天宫，深色木质栈道、深色瓦顶屋檐、垂挂的白色帷幔、反光地面、云海、深夜天空，以及一轮巨大的满月。场景由中国古代宫殿建筑构成，包含巨大的朱红色立柱、金色斗拱、飞檐，以及悬挂的白色帷幔。远处可见深蓝色云海与繁星点点的夜空。

[Visual style] 24fps，8K 超高清，写实级下一代 3D CG 渲染，PBR 物理材质，Lumen 全局光照，体积光，动态运动模糊，自然景深，电影感高对比度光照，干净无噪点画面。高级新中式仙侠美学，UE5 电影级渲染，冷蓝色月光环境光与温暖金色火花、金色暗纹和剑气粒子形成对比。大面积阴影、极简留白、富有表现力的水墨质感、电影级 2.39:1 宽银幕画幅。史诗感、冷峻、孤绝、空灵，并极具震撼力。

[Core visual effects] 黑墨、金色火焰、青白色剑气、金色余烬粒子、流动的墨迹拖尾、环形能量轨迹、新月形剑气，以及墨色冲击波。流动的光轨中包含细小漂浮碎屑和星点粒子，边缘柔和发光。其运动必须保持平滑、连续，不得出现断裂拖尾伪影。所有破坏都遵循物理反馈：被剑气撕裂的帷幔会产生不规则毛边和碎片；木板会开裂、碎裂；墨与水在受击后向外扩散。

[Most important camera rules] 30 秒单镜头，仅使用一台摄像机。绝对不能有剪切、硬切、白闪、黑帧、跳转、瞬移或重新构图。所有画幅和机位变化都必须通过同一台摄像机的连续运动完成。前景白帷幔、墨、水和高速粒子只能作为同一镜头内的遮挡过渡。遮挡结束后，摄像机必须保持在相同的时间、运动方向和空间位置。镜头运动丝滑稳定，在每一次脚步、落地、挥剑和击中点时都带有细微且真实的冲击震动。不要出现随机抖动或失去画面控制。

Storyboard prompt

Shot 1: Complete single-take xianxia sword dance, 0s-30s

0s-2.5s: Distant opening, slow push-in

一个宽幅低机位横向镜头。摄像机起始位置在女性主角身后约 20 米处，沿着一条深色木质栈道的中心线缓慢向前推进。她背对摄像机站在巨大的满月之下，渺小如尘埃，黑色剪影被月光清晰勾勒出来。

她开始非常缓慢地向前行走，双臂自然垂在身侧，随后逐渐收紧右手握住长剑。长发和宽袖在夜风中向后飘动；白色裙摆在略低重力的环境中缓慢浮起。每一步之间大约相隔 1.5 秒。摄像机有约两个像素的垂直轻微起伏，以及极其轻微的左右偏移，营造出真实的手持跟拍感。

她脚下的反光地面映出满月、她的剪影，以及远处金色宫殿建筑的模糊倒影。远处白色悬挂帷幔缓慢摇曳。空间安静，只有风声、流动的雾气，以及布料摩擦的声音。

2.5s-5s: Forward lean, rapid sprint to the right

同一条连续的摄像机路径平滑地从她正后方转向她的右前侧，同时加速前进。她突然前倾，降低重心，高速冲向画面右侧。

她的右脚重重踏地，在木板上造成细小裂纹和木刺飞溅。她的蓝黑色长袍、长发和宽袖被加速度猛烈向后拉扯。白色裙摆在反光地面上拖出一条很长的金色火焰与黑墨混合尾迹，并清晰映出倒影。

摄像机随着她的加速产生细微动态震动，而她始终保持清晰，背景建筑则出现强烈的运动视差。

5s-7.5s: High-speed sword swing, tearing the first white curtain

她冲向右前景一幅巨大的白色悬挂帷幔。摄像机保持在她的右前侧，以侧前方跟拍的方式匹配她的速度，并略微降低形成中低机位视角。

她没有停下冲刺，而是拔剑并完成一次从后向前的大幅水平斩击。剑刃划破空气，释放出一弧青白色、边缘带金的剑气。

剑气击中白色帷幔。布料先向内凹陷，随后从受击点向外撕裂，形成不规则毛边、散落线头和大量碎片。白色布片被气流卷向镜头，形成自然的前景遮挡。摄像机不切镜，继续跟随她穿过四散的碎片。

7.5s-10s: Midair rotation, circular sword energy forms

穿过白布碎片后，摄像机继续向右前方移动，并围绕她做一个平滑的小半径环绕，不会突然改变方向。

借助冲刺的惯性，她跃入空中。双脚离开栈道，身体围绕垂直轴快速旋转。她先收拢双臂，再随着旋转展开宽袖。黑发划出优雅弧线，裙摆如水墨花瓣般绽开。

长剑随身体持续运动，在她前方形成一个巨大的环形能量轨迹，金白与青色光芒交织其中。圆环内部有墨色扩散、金色火花、细小漂浮粒子和柔和发光边缘。环形剑气扫过地面，在下方反光表面形成明亮的圆形倒影。

10s-12.5s: Rising before the moon, continuous crescent sword-energy strikes

摄像机自然随她的旋转上升，从中景转为宽幅低机位视角。她在巨大的满月前形成黑色剪影。冷蓝色月光勾勒出她的头发、剑刃和裙摆边缘。

她双手持剑，在空中连续完成三次猛烈挥剑：

第一下，水平斩释放出一道青白色的新月形剑气弧。

第二下，向上斜斩以上升的能量轨迹撕开雾气。

第三下，转身反手斩释放出更大的金青交织剑弧。

三次攻击之间不能有停顿。她的身体旋转、肩部发力、腰部扭转、袖摆滞后以及剑气释放必须构成完整的因果链。能量从她身侧掠过，带着黑墨与金色火花。

12.5s-15s: Sword energy cuts through space, camera follows the attack path

摄像机短暂锁定剑尖，然后沿着剑气的方向快速向前推进，同时保持与她的空间连接。剑气切开前方数层白色悬挂帷幔，依次将其斩裂，在前景到远处之间形成一条破碎走廊。

白色布片、灰色墨迹、金色火花和青白色剑气以交错轨迹掠过镜头，形成强烈的放射状运动模糊。画面可以被高速碎片短暂遮挡，但绝不能
